text: dsh-notification 是一款 DSH 网页端通知插件：它在主机侧把每个会话最近一轮的结束原因、回复摘要和工具名折叠成有长度上限的投影，再由客户端根据会话状态、用户偏好和浏览器权限显示桌面通知。通知可按正常完成、错误、中止、阻塞和 Token 上限分别启停，也能在审批、问题回答或计划评审等待时提醒。设置页提供包含或排除关键词规则，支持正则和大小写选项，并可管理通知权限、发送测试通知、要求手动关闭或仅在任务不在当前视图时通知。偏好保存在浏览器中，适合需要离开 DSH 标签页时留意任务进展的网页端用户；需保持网页打开并授予浏览器通知权限。

dsh-notification shows browser alerts for DSH turn outcomes and pending approvals, questions, or plan reviews. Users can filter by keywords and choose which situations notify from the web settings page. It requires browser notification permission and an open DSH page.
DSH 跑完一轮后能不能在浏览器里提醒我？
我切到别的标签页时，想知道任务什么时候结束。
让网页端按任务成功、出错或中止分别决定要不要通知。
我想只在回复里出现某些关键词时收到提醒，也过滤掉不想看的内容。
DSH 等我审批或回答问题时，可以弹个通知吗？
Can my browser alert me when a DSH turn finishes or fails?
I want alerts only when a reply or tool name matches my keyword rules.
How can I get notified when the assistant is waiting for my approval or answer?
dsh-notification 的功能「任务结束通知」：会话新一轮投影到达后，根据结束原因生成浏览器通知计划。用户可分别开启完成、错误、中止、阻塞和达到 Token 上限的通知；通知标题按原因选择，正文使用本轮回复摘要。
dsh-notification 的功能「待处理交互提醒」：会话进入审批、等待回答或计划评审状态时，可按各自开关显示通知；提示正文采用会话标题，并给每次等待生成独立标签。
dsh-notification 的功能「关键词筛选」：设置包含或排除规则，按会话标题、回复文本和工具名匹配；支持普通子串或正则表达式，并可选择区分大小写。排除命中会抑制通知，存在包含规则时至少命中一条才放行。
dsh-notification 的功能「通知偏好设置」：设置页可切换总开关、各结束状态和待处理状态的通知，编辑并保存规则，选择通知是否需手动关闭，以及是否只在当前会话不在视野中时提醒。偏好通过本地快照存储持久化。
dsh-notification 的功能「通知权限和测试」：设置页显示当前浏览器权限状态，提供请求权限及发送测试通知的操作；权限未授予时会显示对应提示，通知构造失败时也会返回错误信息供界面说明。
dsh-notification 使用前须知：需授予浏览器通知权限，未获授权时不会创建通知（见 src/client/notifier.ts:83-86）。
dsh-notification needs the web page open and browser notifications available (see src/client/index.ts:124-180).

dsh-notification README · dsh-notification：Desktop notifications for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. When a session finishes a turn, the browser shows a system notification (via the `Notification` API), so you can switch tabs and still know when DSH is done. Per-outcome toggles and include/exclude keyword rules control exactly which completions notify.

dsh-notification README · dsh-notification：No harness change is needed: the host contributes a session projection (a bounded summary of each session's last completed turn), and the client watches the session list's completion reminder and applies its own persisted preferences.

dsh-notification README · dsh-notification：```
host:  notification projection (last turn's reason/text/tools) --session/projection--> browser
client: session list completion reminder (live, dedup) + persisted settings
        -> permission + current-session visibility gate
        -> new Notification("DSH finished", { body: "deploy done" })

dsh-notification README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-notification/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.4.tar.gz
```

Restart the web server so the host half and the served client bundle pick up the plugin. The default `dsh web` profile has the required client composition (the session list, the settings shell, and locale).

Version `0.1.4` supports both the 0.1.1 and 0.1.2 Harness client package layouts and projection contracts.

The settings section lives under **Settings > Notifications**.

dsh-notification README · Settings：| Setting | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enable notifications | on | Master switch; off stops every notification while keeping rules. |
| Notify on completed / error / aborted / blocked / token limit | completed + error on, rest off | Which turn-end reasons notify (the host projection reports the reason). |
| Keyword rules | none | Include/exclude filters matched against the session title, the turn's reply text, and its tool names. Include rules: at least one must match. Exclude rules: a match suppresses. Rules support literal or regex matching with an optional case-sensitive flag. |
| Require manual dismiss | off | The notification stays until dismissed. |
| Only notify when the task is out of view | on | Suppress a notification only when its session is currently in view. A completion still notifies while the page is hidden or while another session/workspace is open. Turn it off to notify even for the session being watched. Notifications for the same session replace each other. |
dsh-notification README · Settings：Preferences persist in the browser (localStorage). The section also grants browser permission and sends a test notification.

dsh-notification README · Configuration：Host-side tunables live on the plugin row in `cordis.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-notification
  name: dsh-notification
  config:
    maxBodyChars: 400      # projection body budget; longer replies are ellipsized host-side

dsh-notification README · Model experience：| Aspect | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Token cost | None — notifications are UI-only and never enter a request. |
| Tool calls | None — the model gets no new tool. |
| Session log | Unchanged — the projection reads the existing log and adds no events. |
| Prompt | Unchanged — no system-prompt section is registered. |

dsh-notification README · Permission boundary：- The host folds a pure projection over the session log (turn reason, bounded reply text, tool names) and the projection seam delivers it to the browser; the plugin writes nothing to the log and registers no model-facing tools.
- The client watches the session list's completion reminder (a live "finished while not selected" edge the runtime already computes) and shows a notification only when the user has granted Notification permission.
- Rule matching runs client-side against the projected content; the reply body never exceeds `maxBodyChars`.

dsh-notification README · Development：```sh
pnpm install            # links the sibling dsh checkout for build and tests
pnpm run check          # typecheck + tests + build
pnpm run test           # vitest (host projection + composition, client decision/runner/helpers/section)
pnpm run build          # esbuild host/client/invariant bundles + tsc declarations

dsh-notification README · Development：The repo expects the harness checkout at `../dsh` for the dev-time `link:` resolutions. The composition spec boots the real `SessionStore` and `SessionProjectionRegistry` and proves the fold.

dsh-notification README · Known limitations：- Notifications require the page to be open (the browser shows them while it is hidden, but not after the tab is closed) and Notification permission granted; a denied site permission cannot be overridden from inside the page.
- Notifications fire once per finished turn (a running→idle edge on any session); a completion that happened while the page was disconnected is not re-notified on reconnect.
- The rule subject is the session title plus the last turn's reply text and tool names — earlier turns are not matched.
- Notification body is a flat text snippet; the click action only focuses the window (no deep link to the turn).
